eps_screen.desc: Energy-screen FIR emissivity to sky (aluminized/low-e). Separate from epsil5 so it only affects the screen-sky term r12 when the screen is deployed (U1>0); U1=0 on the venting calibration day, so calibration-safe.
eps_screen.comment: Added V2.2: makes the thermal screen a heat-retaining ENERGY screen. Was implicitly epsil5=1 (full-emissivity shade screen).

k_ground.desc: Effective air<->ground conductance via the floor thermal-mass state (single, identifiable)
k_ground.comment: Added V2.2: replaces the degenerate h_soil/k_deep pair. Charges the fixed-capacity floor from air and discharges to deep-soil Tsoil. Calibrated on venting-day data: k_ground=4.33 W/m2/K, 95% CI [1.45, 7.82] (run_inference_venting.jl).

h_soil.desc: Effective air<->floor convective heat-exchange coefficient (thermal-mass buffer)
h_soil.comment: Added V2.2: lumped air-floor coupling for the dynamic floor/soil state. Calibratable.

C_soil.desc: Heat capacity per floor area of the active soil/floor layer (thermal mass)
C_soil.comment: Added V2.2: floor heat capacity. ~0.15 m active soil layer. Calibratable.

k_deep.desc: Conductance from the active floor layer to the fixed deep-soil temperature
k_deep.comment: Added V2.2: deep-soil anchor conductance; deep-soil temp = weather Tsoil. Calibratable.

alpha1.desc: Heat capacity of one square meter of the canopy

alpha2.desc: Global NIR absorption coefficient of the canopy (V2.2 r5: fixed share of outside NIR, independent of LAI). Note 103: under solar_cons used only for the lamp NIR part of r5; 0.35 is Vanthoor's canopy NIR REFLECTION (see rho_can_nir)

alpha4.desc: Convection heat exchange coefficient of canopy leaf to greenhouse air

alpha5.desc: Specific heat capacity of greenhouse air

alpha7.desc: Global NIR absorption coefficient of the floor

alpha8.desc: PAR absorption coefficient of the cover

alpha9.desc: NIR absorption coefficient of the cover

alpha12.desc: Total lamp radiation per square meter

beta1.desc: Canopy extinction coefficient for PAR radiation

beta2.desc: Extinction coefficient for PAR radiation reflected from the floor to the canopy

beta3.desc: Canopy extinction coefficient for NIR radiation

gamma1.comment: ok, usé el valor de Texas

gamma3.desc: Strength of boundary layer of canopy for vapor transport

gamma4.desc: Minimum stomatal resistance of the canopy

gamma5.desc: Inverse of slope of the differentiable switch for the stomatal resistance model

delta1.desc: Radiation above the canopy that defines sunrise and sunset

delta4.desc: Coefficient of the CO2 transpiration in the day

delta5.desc: Coefficient of the CO2 transpiration in the night

delta6.desc: Coefficient of the vapour pressure in the day

delta7.desc: Coefficient of the vapour pressure in the night

epsil1.desc: FIR emission coefficient of the heating pipe

eta1.desc: Proportion of global radiation that is absorbed by greenhouse building elements

eta2.desc: Ratio between PAR radiation and external global radiation

eta3.desc: Ratio between NIR radiation and global external radiation

eta4.desc: Conversion factor for CO2 of mg*m**−3 to ppm

eta6.comment: Value computed from vanthorr´s thesis ec 8.70 with zeta = 0.33

eta7.desc: Ratio between ceiling ventilation area and total ventilation area
eta7.comment: no dan valor en el artículo

eta8.desc: Ratio between ceiling and total ventilation area, if there is no chimney effect

eta10.desc: Shadow effect on the discharge coefficient
eta10.comment: Falta valor, en los ejemplos del artículo no se considera

eta11.desc: Effect of shadow on the global wind pressure coefficient

eta12.desc: Amount of vapor that is released when a joule of sensible energy is produced by the direct air heater

eta13.desc: Amount of CO2 that is released when a joule of sensible energy is produced by the direct air heater

eta14.desc: Percentage lamps radiation that is NIR

eta15.desc: Porcentaje de la radiacion de las lamparas que es calor en el reflector

eta16.desc: Porcentaje de la radiacion de las lamparas que es calor directo al aire del invernadero

eta17.desc: Percentage lamps radiation that is PAR

lamb1.desc: Performance coefficient of the mechanical cooling system
lamb1.comment: Falta valor, en los ejemplos del artículo no se considera

lamb2.desc: Electrical capacity of the mechanical cooling system
lamb2.comment: Falta valor, en los ejemplos del artículo no se considera

lamb3.desc: Convective heat exchange coefficient between soil and greenhouse air
lamb3.comment: 1 . Falta valor, en los ejemplos del artículo no se considera

lamb4.desc: Heat capacity of direct air heater
lamb4.comment: Valor de la tesis de Vanthoor Pblow = 0.5 MW

lamb5.comment: ok,tomé el valor de Holanda, el de Texas es muy grande (9e4)

lamb6.desc: Variable of heat exchange by convection between the roof and the outside air
lamb6.comment: 2.8 ok, usé el valor de Texas

lamb7.desc: Variable of heat exchange by convection between the roof and the outside air
lamb7.comment: 1 ok, usé el valor de Texas

lamb8.desc: Variable of heat exchange by convection between the roof and the outside air

lamb9.desc: eficiencia del intercambio de calor entre las capas de aire

rho1.desc: PAR reflection coefficient of the cannopy

rho3.comment: El valor es el de la densidad del aire al nivel del mar

rho4.comment: El valor es el de la densidad del aire al nivel del mar

tau1.desc: PAR transmission coefficient of the Cover
tau1.comment: En el artículo no dan su valor

tau2.desc: FIR transmission coefficient of the Cover
tau2.comment: En el artículo no dan su valor

tau3.desc: FIR transmission coefficient of the thermal screen
tau3.comment: ok --> usé el valor de Texas

nu1.comment: Ne Vanthoor estaba Ventilation discharge coefficient depends o de 0.65 creo que esta mal

nu2.desc: Global wind pressure coefficient without shadow

nu3.comment: Usamos la proporcion dada en Vanthor

nu4.comment: Vanthoor value 1e-4. Data-validated: after the V2.2 vent-sign + roof-vent(h7) fixes the ODE is stable at 1e-4 (sweep_leakage.jl) and the venting-day MCMC posterior excludes 1e-2 (run_inference_venting.jl). Restored to physical.

nu4CO2.comment: Este es iun invento propio para medir la diferencia entre las fugas de calor y de CO2

nu6.desc: Vertical dimension of a single open respirator

phi1.desc: External diameter of the heating pipe

phi5.desc: Water vapor contained in the fan-pad system

phi6.desc: Water vapor contained in the outside air
phi6.comment: este es el valor correcto a 21 grados C y 50 % de HR

phi7.desc: Capacity of air flow through the pad

phi8.desc: Air flow capacity of forced ventilation system

psi2.desc: Capacity of the external CO2 source
psi2.comment: se modifico para ajustarse a los datos de holanda Authonomous Greenhouse challenge. estaba en 13300, probably wrong

omega3.desc: Percentage of CO2 absorbed by the canopy
omega3.comment: Deberia depender del modelo de la planta

RH.desc: Relative humidity percentage in the greenhouse air

lambda.desc: Constante de la ecuacion para U7

U7_c.desc: Punto final para el control U7

U6_c.desc: Punto final para el control U6

Potential_value.desc: Value in EURos per sq meter of potted tomato plants currently in greenhouse

PARsum.desc: Suma del PAR que recibe el canopy por dia (moles * m-2 * dia-1)

use_cover_node.desc: Algebraic cover thermal node: 0=off (V2.2 default, bit-for-bit), 1=on (buffered T_cover replaces T_sky in inside-facing LW terms)

h_cover_out.desc: Cover-to-outside convective heat transfer coefficient [W/(m2 K)]. Active only when use_cover_node=1. Treated as constant (inferred from data).

nu4_min.desc: Minimum infiltration/leakage rate regardless of wind speed [m3/(m2 s)]. 0=off (V2.2 default, bit-for-bit). Active independently of nu4; floor on f6.

U8_min_leak.desc: Minimum effective roof-vent opening fraction due to seal imperfections [dimensionless, 0-1]. 0=off (V2.2 default, bit-for-bit). Applied as max(U8, U8_min_leak) in the f7 buoyancy-vent rate; represents physical residual airflow when actuator commands closure.

heat_ctrl.desc: Heating PI controller flag (0=off: V2.2 behaviour; 1=on: pipe driven to hold air at U11+hc_dT when the logged pipe is off)

hc_Kp.desc: Heating controller proportional gain (pipe-air K per K of setpoint error)

hc_Ki.desc: Heating controller integral gain (= hc_Kp / tau_i, tau_i = 30 min)

hc_Tmax.desc: Maximum heating-pipe temperature (65 C; AiCU PipeLow peaks at 66.5 C)

hc_dT.desc: Offset added to the heating setpoint U11 (zone/sensor offset; inferable)

vent_exp.desc: Roof-vent effectiveness exponent: effective opening = U8^vent_exp (1 = linear, V2.2)

vent_screen.desc: Flag: closed energy screen throttles roof ventilation of crop air (0 = off, V2.2)

vent_scr_perm.desc: Fraction of roof ventilation reaching the crop air through a fully closed energy screen

stomata_fix.desc: Flag: correct stomatal-resistance day/night switch orientation and CO2 units (ppm) in q4 (0 = off, V2.2)

vapour_fix.desc: Flag: Vanthoor-consistent condensation sinks (p7 gated by mech. cooling U3; p8 with U1 factor and |T_air - T_screen|) (0 = off, V2.2)

cond_heat.desc: Flag: return a fraction f_cond of the latent heat of screen condensation (p8) to the air energy balance (0 = off, V2.2)

f_cond.desc: Fraction of screen-condensation latent heat returned to the crop air (rest leaves via the cover)

vent_ctrl.desc: Flag: closed-loop roof vents (Note 34), opening = state u[7] (0 = off, replay logged U8)

vc_gain.desc: Vent controller gain: opening per K above (VentSP + vc_e0)

vc_e0.desc: Vent controller start offset relative to the vent setpoint

vc_hum.desc: Vent opening for humidity control when the air is too humid

vc_hband.desc: Humidity band over which the humidity opening ramps to vc_hum

pipe_lag.desc: Flag: first-order lag on the heat_ctrl pipe temperature, state u[8] (0 = off)

black_scr.desc: Flag: blackout screen adds to energy-screen closure, U1_eff = 1-(1-U1)(1-k_black*BlackScr) (0 = off)

k_black.desc: Insulation weight of the blackout screen relative to the energy screen

vc_night_log.desc: Flag (Note 38, with vent_ctrl): at night replay the logged vent opening instead of the controller (0 = off)

vc_min_night.desc: Minimum vent opening at night with vent_ctrl (0 = off)

vc_night_I.desc: Global radiation below which vc_night_log / vc_min_night apply

hc_log_pipe.desc: Flag (Note 42, with heat_ctrl): where the logged pipe is warm (> air + 1 K) only the logged pipe heats; PI only elsewhere (0 = off)

vc_min_log.desc: Flag (Note 42, with vent_ctrl): minimum vent opening from the logged VentLeewMin setpoint input (0 = off)

soil_dyn.desc: Flag (Note 43): deep-soil anchor is state u[9] following the floor T with time constant sd_tau, instead of fixed Tsoil (0 = off)

sd_tau.desc: Deep-soil time constant for soil_dyn (7 days)

floor_full.desc: Flag (Note 46): close the floor energy balance - floor FIR to sky (r11), canopy FIR to floor (r14, on T1) and Vanthoor air-floor conduction (h11) are booked into the floor state (0 = off, V2.2)

solar_split.desc: Flag (Note 46): global radiation absorbed by the cover (cov_abs*I2) heats the cover node instead of the air (V2.0 put 1.0*I2 into the air via alpha8, alpha9); the floor absorbs the transmitted sun not intercepted by the canopy (0 = off, V2.2)

cov_abs.desc: Fraction of global radiation absorbed by the cover, used only with solar_split (glass: ~1 - tau1 - reflection 0.13)

deep_k.desc: Flag (Note 46): floor -> deep-soil link uses its own conductance k_deep instead of k_ground (0 = off, V2.2)

mass_node.desc: Flag (Note 48): lumped internal thermal mass (structure, substrate, crop and pipe water) as state u[10], coupled to the air by h_mass; absorbs f_mass*Iglob (0 = off, V2.2)

C_mass.desc: Heat capacity of the internal mass node (mass_node); ~12 L water per m2 = 5e4

f_mass.desc: Share of outside global radiation absorbed by the internal mass (mass_node); additional to the other solar terms

dday.desc: Daytime observation offset (Note 50, calibration n49a only): compared air T = model air T + dday when Iglob > 50 W m-2. Not used by the engine; a measurement/representation term (crop-height sensor vs well-mixed air node).

lamp_full.desc: Note 54 flag: full lamp electrical power into canopy+air (default off)

lamp_Pel.desc: Lamp electrical power at 100% (AGC-2018: 187 umol/m2/s / 1.6 umol/J)

lamp_fcan.desc: Share of lamp power absorbed by a closed canopy (PAR+NIR), Note 54

vent_split.desc: Note 58 flag: leeward (U8) and windward (U7) roof vents as two flows (default off)

vs_exp.desc: Note 58: curvature of opening -> flow for each side (1 = linear)

vs_gwind.desc: Note 58: windward discharge multiplier relative to leeward

vs_clee.desc: Note 58: leeward wind-pressure multiplier on nu2

vs_cwind.desc: Note 58: windward wind-pressure multiplier on nu2

lamp_scr_loss.desc: Note 58d: share of lamp power lost through the roof when screens are open (default 0 = off)

air_cap_mult.desc: Note 61: multiplier on the air heat capacity (fast structure/crop/air-volume mass lumped with the air); 1 = V2.2

s_rad.desc: Note 61: measurement model, compared T = air T + s_rad*Iglob/100 (sun-heated sensor); 0 = off

phys_light.desc: Note 71 flag: stomata and photosynthesis see sun PAR through the screens (x(1-0.98 BlackScr)(1-0.25 EnScr)) plus lamp PAR lamp_par_W*U12; 0 = sun only (V2.2). DEFAULT ON since Note 72 (user decision)

lamp_par_W.desc: Note 71: lamp PAR at the canopy at 100 % (187 umol m-2 s-1 / 4.6 umol J-1)

photo_lai.desc: Note 71 flag: photosynthesis scaled by the effective leaf area (1-exp(-0.7 LAI))/0.7 instead of the 2.0 'LAI = I9' quirk; 0 = V2.2. DEFAULT ON since Note 72

cover_area.desc: Note 79: cover-to-floor area ratio scaling the cover-sky FIR loss r13 (1.0 = V2.2; AGC compartment ~1.6)

cover_cond.desc: Note 79 flag: condensation of vapour on the cover (Vanthoor MV_AirTop/Cov form, 6.4e-9*1.7|dT|^0.33*(VP-VPsat(Tcov))); 0 = V2.2

co2_resp.desc: Note 79 flag: crop (non-leaf maintenance + growth) respiration as a CO2 source, from the CropResp input series, Q10=2 on canopy T; 0 = V2.2

dew_bl.desc: Note 85 flag: dew on the canopy (Psat(T_canopy) < VP_air) uses only the boundary-layer resistance gamma3, not the stomatal resistance; 0 = V2.2

leak_shared.desc: Note 86 flag: CO2 leakage uses the same coefficient nu4 as heat and vapour (nu4CO2 ignored); 0 = V2.2

rd_q10.desc: Note 86 flag: leaf dark respiration Rd_day x 2^((T_canopy - 25 C)/10); 0 = V2.2 (constant Rd)

leak_stack.desc: Note 88 flag: leakage nu4*sqrt(max(v,0.25)^2 + leak_cs*|T_air-T_out|) (stack effect) and full leakage in the heat balance (V2.2 used 0.5); 0 = V2.2

leak_cs.desc: Note 88: stack coefficient of the leakage (used only with leak_stack = 1)

crop_cap.desc: Note 91 flag: the internal mass node also holds the standing crop (stems, roots, fruits on plant): C = C_mass + crop_cp * CropFW(t); 0 = V2.2

crop_cp.desc: Note 91: specific heat of fresh plant tissue

scr_solar.desc: Note 101 flag: one roof + screen solar calculation (screen_optics.jl, PAR and solar NIR, repeated reflections) attenuates plant PAR AND every below-screen solar heat term (r2, r3, r5 sun, r8, floor, f_mass); screen-intercepted power split into reflection, roof absorption and screen absorption. 0 = V2.2

scr_es_tau_par.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; energy-screen PAR transmission at full closure (organisers: 25 % light interception)

scr_es_rho_par.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; energy-screen PAR reflection; absorption = 1 - tau - rho

scr_es_tau_nir.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; energy-screen solar-NIR transmission, assumed equal to PAR

scr_es_rho_nir.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; energy-screen solar-NIR reflection, assumed equal to PAR

scr_bl_tau_par.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; blackout-screen PAR transmission at full closure (organisers: 98 % light interception)

scr_bl_rho_par.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; blackout-screen PAR reflection; absorption = 1 - tau - rho

scr_bl_tau_nir.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; blackout-screen solar-NIR transmission, assumed equal to PAR

scr_bl_rho_nir.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; blackout-screen solar-NIR reflection, assumed equal to PAR

roof_rho_par.desc: Note 103: roof (glass + structure) PAR reflection, either face; < 0 = derived so that the roof absorbs eta1 (structure) + cov_abs (glass), as V2.2 books with screens retracted: rho = 1 - (1-eta1) tau1 - eta1 - cov_abs (0.15 in n79). Was 0.13 in Note 101 (PROVISIONAL)

roof_rho_nir.desc: Note 103: roof (glass + structure) solar-NIR reflection, either face; < 0 = derived so that the roof absorbs eta1 (structure) + cov_abs (glass), as V2.2 books with screens retracted: rho = 1 - (1-eta1) tau1 - eta1 - cov_abs (0.15 in n79). Was 0.13 in Note 101 (PROVISIONAL)

roof_tau_nir.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; roof solar-NIR transmission for the screen stack; < 0 = same as PAR, (1 - eta1) tau1

scr_order.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; 0 = energy screen above the blackout screen, 1 = blackout above (changes only how absorption splits between the screens)

scr_abs_air.desc: PROVISIONAL (Note 101): no measured optical data for the AiCU screens/roof; share of the solar absorbed by the screens released to the crop air (lower face); the rest goes to the cover/structure node

solar_cons.desc: Note 103 flag: energy-conserving solar column per band (PAR, NIR): roof -> energy/blackout screens -> canopy (t = exp(-k LAI), r = rho_inf (1 - t)) -> opaque floor, all repeated reflections; books canopy, floor, roof (eta1 structure -> air, glass -> cover), screens, sky; replaces r2, r3, r5(sun), r8, cov_abs, floor solar and the plant PAR of phys_par. Supersedes scr_solar. 0 = V2.2

rho_can_nir.desc: Note 103: canopy solar-NIR reflection approached at high LAI (rho_inf; Vanthoor 2011 reference value 0.35, eqs 8.31-8.32). NOT an absorption share: V2.2 used 0.35 as a fixed canopy NIR absorption (alpha2)

solar_mass_share.desc: Note 103 flag (with solar_cons): the internal mass takes f_mass of the floor-level solar absorption (conserving) instead of f_mass * Iglob on top of everything (V2.2). f_mass then means a share 0-1 of floor-level absorption, so its prior must be re-centred

par_below.desc: Note 105 flag: photosynthesis and stomata see the PAR on BOTH canopy faces (top + floor-reflected light reaching the underside, after all returns): climate model with solar_cons (ParTop + ParBot = absorbed canopy PAR / a); crop calibration on measured light via par_both_faces_factor(LAI). 0 = top-of-canopy PAR only
